title: Observation Instruments
body: Build criteria and categories, code behaviour against video frame by frame, and keep several observers on the same register.

title: T-Pattern Explorer
body: Detect repeating temporal patterns in coded observations. Tune minimum occurrences, significance and granularity, then jump to every occurrence in the video.

title: Predictive Assistant
body: While you code, LINCE PLUS suggests the next likely events with expected timing and a confidence score.

title: Sensor Sync
body: Overlay heart rate, accelerometer and gyroscope streams on the video timeline with a single synchronised playhead.

title: Python Research Notebook
body: An in-app notebook with pandas, numpy, matplotlib and scipy, with your observation data preloaded as a DataFrame.

title: Agreement And Exports
body: Inter-observer agreement with kappa indices, PDF reports, and exports to Theme 5/6, GSEQ, Hoisan and Excel.
